Gracefully handles broken HTML without crashing

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import create_engine, scrape

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(result.html)
    print(result.metadata.title)
    print(result.metadata.description)

asyncio.run(main())
```
